name: Grand Tour de Paris, liaison Pont d’Austerlitz
description_md:
The Grand Tour de Paris, liaison Pont d'Austerlitz is a waymarked hiking route located in France. This national waymarked hiking network path is signposted as GR 11.

The route spans 62.3 km with 797 m of ascent and 850 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent, requiring about 18 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The trail passes Paris (Orly) within 1800 m, Paris (Beauvais) within 1800 m, and Notre Dame Treasure within 1300 m.
